svg.title: DualMind Arena — cover story
svg.desc: Cover story, DualMind Labs: DualMind Arena, live. Blind, head-to-head AI model evaluation. Public AI benchmarks are easy to game: cherry-picked prompts, brand bias, results nobody can audit. Two models answer the same real prompt with their names hidden; the community votes before the identities are revealed, and the votes feed a live leaderboard. Box score: 5,000+ requests absorbed in one traffic spike (Bots + real users; Cloudflare CDN took the load before it reached the origin.); #1 on Google for “DualMind Labs” (dualmindlab.tech); Real-time login anomaly detection (IP capture, risk scoring and an email alert to the account owner on every suspicious event.); Docs full user documentation, published (docs.dualmindlab.tech). Next: Expanding from model evaluation into AI agent evaluation. Visit arena.dualmindlab.tech.
